text:
mira: Hey folks — we need a Console card to correlate per-route p50/p95/p99 spikes with kernel selection, batching behavior, and KV cache hit rate. Current panels only show latency + throughput; we need attribution to help root-cause regressions (kernel switch vs cache cold vs batching).

andrew: +1. The big ask is being able to click a route and see: timeseries (p50/p95/p99), throughput, error rate, kv_hit_rate, kernel_tag distribution, and a small table of top slow traces.

simon: Do we already emit kernel_tag for each request? runtime currently logs kernel_selector in the request metadata, but ingestion might not map it to route metrics yet. cc @jen for ingest mapping.

jen: We don't expose kv_hit_rate per-route in Console today — only global aggregated metrics. We can add a transform to compute per-route per-minute kv_hit_rate and kernel_usage%. Question: do you want token-level waterfalls in the same panel or a drilldown?

mira: Drilldown is fine. Default: per-minute aggregates for the card. Drilldown: top 5 slow requests with token-level waterfall and trace id link. Also filters by model_family and seq_len_bucket.

andrew: UI idea: left column timeseries p50/p95/p99 stacked with a secondary axis for throughput; below that a stacked area showing kernel usage (cpu-optimized vs gpu-optimized) and kv_hit_rate as an overlay line. Right column: table of top slow traces with quick actions (open trace, open request payload).

simon: infra request: @infra-bot can we add metrics to the scrape job to include route.kernel_selector, route.kv_hit (boolean per request) and route.batch_size? Also emit token_waterfall when available.

infra-bot: telemetry-scrape-update scheduled: 2024-09-15T03:00:00Z. New metrics to be emitted: route.kernel_selector, route.kv_hit (0/1), route.batch_size, route.seq_len_bucket, and token_waterfall_summary.

jen: I'll add ingestion transforms: compute kv_hit_rate = avg(route.kv_hit::int) per route/minute and kernel_usage = count_by(kernel_selector)/total. Also plan to attach a "perf_root_cause" tag during ingest using a simple heuristic.

mira: Heuristic idea: if p99 increases >20% and kv_hit_rate drops >15% over same window -> tag kv_cold; if kernel_usage shows a sudden increase in cpu-fallback -> kernel_fallback; if p90_batch_size > batching_threshold -> batching_high. Keep it conservative.

andrew: Sounds good. For SLOs: add an alert when route.p99 > baseline * 1.2 AND kv_hit_rate < baseline - 0.15 for 3m. That should catch cache regressions triggering latency spikes.

simon: Quick SQL we can use for initial QA on aggregated table:

```
SELECT route, minute,
  percentile(latency_ms, 50) AS p50,
  percentile(latency_ms, 95) AS p95,
  percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99,
  avg(route_kv_hit::int) AS kv_hit_rate,
  approx_percentile(batch_size, 0.9) AS p90_batch
FROM requests
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY route, minute
```

jen: I'll wire that into the Console card as the default query and add a sample view for token_waterfall. Also adding a new ingestion enum field perf_root_cause with values: kv_cold, kernel_fallback, batching_high, unknown.

mira: Can we also include a small donut showing kernel attribution for the current window and an inline sparklines mini-card for kv_hit_rate? UX should make it obvious whether p99 is driven by kernel changes or cache behavior.

andrew: I'll mock up the figma layout: timeseries + kernel donut + kv sparkline + slow-trace table. Will add a small legend and color mapping for kernel tags. Target design done by end of next week.

simon: Timeline summary: infra scrape change -> ingest mapping -> Console card -> SLO alert + figma mock. Can we target next sprint (2 weeks) for a first pass?

jen: Agree. I'll own ingest work and perf_root_cause tag.

andrew: I'll own dashboard figma + Console dashboard implementation (small card).

mira: I'll own the SLOs and follow-up QA. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: deploy will require a brief telemetry rollout; metric names may change during rollout window. I'll post if we need any consumer migration.

mira: Cool — tagging tasks in roadmap. If anyone spots missing telemetry keys, ping here and we'll prioritize.
